id.description: Deterministic identifier within a single extraction result.

text.description: The block's text content, as reflected in document.text.

start_byte.description: Start UTF-8 byte offset within document.text (inclusive).

end_byte.description: End UTF-8 byte offset within document.text (exclusive).

children.description: Optional structure edges. In flat mode, all leaves still appear in document.blocks.

role.description: Optional cross-format semantic role hint (unstable; evolves within v0).
